# teams_guest_calling_configuration (Resource)

Manages the GuestCallingConfiguration configuration via Set-CsTeamsGuestCallingConfiguration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `allow_private_calling` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowPrivateCalling parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
